messages:
mira: FYI PR #16725 CI microbench failing on kernel-selector perf unit. Tail latency up ~22% on kv-hotpath. Logs: https://ci.redwood.company/ci/16725

ci-bot: Build 16725-microbench failed: threshold_diff=+22.3% (kv_batcher_latency)

jason: ugh. is it kernel auto-select? any regressed metric besides p95?

mira: looks like p50 +8%, p95 +22%, kv cache hitrate down 6pp. Flamegraph attached (paste below).

mira: ```
# flamegraph snippet
frame: kv_lookup  40%
frame: kernel_dispatch 30%
frame: batch_scheduler 20%
frame: other 10%
```

rohith: can you link the exact commit? I'll try a bisect on the perf-regression job.

mira: commit range: a1b2c3d..f6e7d8c. suspect change in kernel-priority heuristics (PR 16690) that tweaked prefetch ordering.

tasha: possible quick revert? this is blocking merge window.

jason: can we repro locally with regtest? mira, can you paste the perf unit command you used?

mira: repro command:
```
./scripts/run_microbench --bench kv_batcher --iters 200 --seq 256 --model redwood/ggml-13b
```
ran locally on an rtx-a6000 image and saw same delta.

rohith: starting bisect job now: /jobs/perf-bisect?range=a1b2c3d..f6e7d8c target=kv_batcher
I'll post results in ~30m.

ci-bot: perf-bisect job queued (id 8921)

mira: /cc @tasha @jason if bisect points to PR 16690 we should revert and open a followup with smaller heuristics delta.

tasha: agree. assign to me for revert if confirmed.

rohith: bisect done: culprit narrowed to commit f1e2d3a (author: lee) — kernel selector change to prefer concat-quant path for seq<300. Full diff: https://git.redwood/commit/f1e2d3a

mira: that matches hypothesis. I can craft a revert PR and include perf unit to guard.

jason: ok proceed with revert and add a perf test that asserts kv_cache_hitrate delta < 3pp. Add @sre-oncall for rollout watch.

mira: created PR 16730 revert + perf regression check. CI triggered.

ci-bot: PR 16730 CI microbench: threshold_diff=+0.5% — looks green :white_check_mark: 

tasha: great. merging in 5m.

mira: thanks everyone. post-merge I'll run 24h shadow to ensure no regressions in production traffic.

jason: thanks, please paste the bisect log into the PR for audit.

mira: will do. :rocket:
